description: Implementation of background process infrastructure including subprocess management, communication, and handshake protocols.

methods.name: cmd2process_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for subprocess commands used in hashmaps.

methods.name: subprocess_find_entry
methods.description: Finds a subprocess entry in a hashmap by command string.

methods.name: subprocess_read_status
methods.description: Reads the status line from a subprocess via a file descriptor.

methods.name: subprocess_stop
methods.description: Stops a subprocess, sends termination signal, and cleans up.

methods.name: subprocess_exit_handler
methods.description: Handles subprocess exit, closes pipes, and waits for shutdown.

methods.name: subprocess_start
methods.description: Starts a new subprocess with specified command and initialization function.

methods.name: subprocess_handshake
methods.description: Performs combined version and capability handshake.
